title: Logo / Logo and clearspace
slide_intent: Keep the wordmark distinct from its surroundings so people can identify it quickly across light and dark settings.
strategic_value: Consistent contrast and protected space can preserve the recognizable Uber word shape in partner communications.
demonstration: The upper row compares white and black wordmarks on opposite backgrounds. The lower row constructs clearspace using the cap height of U.
practical_value: Choose the appropriate logo polarity and reserve its stated clearspace.

content_islands.name: Logo polarity
content_islands.spec: Place explanatory copy left of the paired white-on-black and black-on-white logo specimens in the upper row.

content_islands.name: Clearspace construction
content_islands.spec: Place the clearspace instruction in the lower left and the central white wordmark with repeated U measurements and ghosted surrounding marks in the lower right.

ingredient.name: Uber wordmark
ingredient.role: Identify the brand while remaining distinguishable from neighboring content.
ingredient.application: Use white on darker backgrounds and black on lighter backgrounds; reserve clearspace equal to the cap height of U.
ingredient.scope: October 2018 partner and sponsor guide; measurements apply around the logo.

reference_purposes.Expression: The page compares two contrast treatments of the Uber wordmark.
reference_purposes.Application: It demonstrates reversing the logo on dark backgrounds and constructing its surrounding space from U.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text specifies white on darker backgrounds, black on lighter backgrounds, and clearspace equal to the cap height of U.
